scope: Consolidated negative and exploratory evidence retained after removing superseded probe implementations.

experiments.name: joint_qoi_counterfactual
experiments.headline: Full-covariance compensation did not beat pure scale reliably.

experiments.name: frozen_cstruct_behavior_retention
experiments.headline: Structure matching worsened the primary conditional-gap distance.

experiments.name: scale_residual_qoi
experiments.headline: Residualization helped one fitting design and not the independent design.

experiments.name: ot_planted_pair_recovery
experiments.headline: Exact OT recovered planted pairs, but greedy matching was already perfect at the median.

experiments.name: qoi_behavior_alignment_development
experiments.headline: Only iterations showed retrospective signal; conditional gap did not pass.

experiments.name: qoi_behavior_alignment_holdout
experiments.headline: The development iterations association did not replicate on 26 untouched instances.

experiments.name: per_axis_qoi_signal
experiments.headline: No current axis passed the independent-signal gate after permutation testing and FDR control.

rejected: A universal joint-QoI distance as a solver-behavior proxy
Current individual QoI axes as validated observational behavior proxies
